Title: Search accepts blank input and shows empty results
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://demo.litecart.net/ 2. Click search icon without typing anything
Expected Result: Either a validation or homepage should remain, or a helpful message should display
Actual Result: Search triggers but shows no clear message or guidance; UX unclear

Title: Product image zoom/gallery inconsistent on some products
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open product page with multiple images 2. Click thumbnails or zoom icon
Expected Result: Main image should change and zoom should work consistently
Actual Result: Some thumbnails do not change the main image or zoom does not activate

Title: Cart total/quantity not updating immediately
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Add product to cart 2. Open cart dropdown or cart page
Expected Result: Cart count and total should update immediately
Actual Result: Cart count or total sometimes requires page reload to reflect changes

Title: Thumbnail click does not update main image for certain items
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to a product with multiple thumbnails 2. Click thumbnail 3. Observe main image
Expected Result: Main image should switch to the clicked thumbnail
Actual Result: Main image remains unchanged for some thumbnail clicks

Title: Breadcrumb or category path missing on some category pages
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to a category/subcategory 2. Observe breadcrumb
Expected Result: Breadcrumb should show the correct path (Home > Category > Subcategory)
Actual Result: Breadcrumb is missing or not updated on some navigation flows
